hook: Graphs with n^(1+o(1)) vertices contain every n-vertex graph from any proper minor-closed class.
hook_turn: contain every n-vertex graph from any proper minor-closed class.
summary: For any fixed proper minor-closed graph class, the authors construct a graph with n^(1+o(1)) vertices and edges containing every n-vertex graph of the class as an induced subgraph. This extends earlier results for planar graphs and beats the previous O(n^2) vertex bound. It is an existence result whose bounds hide a sub-polynomial factor, and it is purely theoretical.
title: You Can Have It All: Small sparse induced-universal graphs for minor-closed classes
